> [!CAUTION]
> **DO NOT SUBMIT PUBLIC ISSUES FOR UNPATCHED CRITICAL VULNERABILITIES OR 0-DAYS.**  
> Please review our [Security Policy](../../SECURITY.md) and report vulnerabilities privately to **`security@asterixos.org`**.

If you are reporting a non-sensitive configuration bug or general security hardening recommendation:

### 1. Affected Component
- (e.g. `termux-mobile/install-termux.sh`, `scripts-hub/ax-deb-builder.py`, PRoot container permissions)

### 2. Vulnerability Description
- Detailed explanation of the vulnerability or risk.

### 3. Impact Assessment
- What can an attacker achieve? Under what threat model?

### 4. Proposed Fix / Patch
- Suggested remediation or patch code.
